mentions.name: dve
mentions.description: A semantic embedder and vector database combined into one project, focused on Apple devices. It provides drop-in semantic vector search for any text, so users don't have to pick models, manage a database, handle data processing, or deal with performance concerns.
mentions.problem: Setting up semantic search normally requires worrying about which models and database to use, how the data is processed, and performance concerns.
